title: Improve delivery reliability
problem: Delivery dates are frequently missed and the causes are unclear.
objective: Identify actionable areas for improving delivery reliability.
facts: Three recent releases missed their target date.
assumptions: Planning and handoffs contribute to delay.

framework_data.root_question: What parts of the delivery system should be examined?
framework_data.coverage_check: The tree covers planning and execution stages.
framework_data.overlap_check: Branches use delivery lifecycle stage as the organizing rule.

risks: The current sample may be too small to identify all causes.
open_questions: Which stage contributes the most delay?
next_actions: Collect cycle-time data by delivery stage.
